$description: Per-theme button colors, pushed into Penpot's theme/light and theme/dark sets by build-penpot-tokens.js. These existed only inside the Penpot file until 2026-08-22, where a token import would silently delete them (import replaces same-named sets, and theme/light + theme/dark are both generated). Ten Button variants bind their fill to one of these, so losing them breaks the component. Token names are emitted verbatim — NOT under the color.* prefix the semanticColors entries get — because the existing Penpot bindings reference them as button.*. The CSS computes these live with color-mix() in oklab; the hexes below are the flattened result and can drift. See the audit note in _local/generated/ for the plan to make the build do the mixing itself.
